description: Use when an agent needs events similar to a given event — cross-platform equivalents and topically-related markets, precomputed nightly from title embeddings. Best-first; empty list (never an error) when no similarities are known yet. Before quoting an event price, check the market's `quote_tier` in `get_event` or `get_market`.

event_id.description: Event id native to the source.

page_size.description: Alias for limit. Both values must agree.

name: get_event_similar
title: Find similar and cross-platform events
